title: Adam Sandler Officiated Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce’s Wedding
content:
ByJack Dunn

Adam SandlerofficiatedTaylor SwiftandTravis Kelce‘s star-studded Madison Square Garden wedding.

The reveal came via a press release obtained byVarietyin the minutes following Swift and Kelce’sofficial marriage announcement. It also included several other miscellaneous details about the ceremony and wedding day looks.

“The bride and groom’s wedding ceremony looks have been created by Christian Dior Haute Couture. They are designed by Jonathan Anderson, Creative Director of Dior Women’s, Men’s and Haute Couture Collections, in close collaboration with the Bride and Groom,” read the release. “This is the designer’s first couture wedding dress for a world-renowned celebrity. Their shoes were custom made by Christian Louboutin and the bride wore Cartier jewelry.”

It continued, “Taylor & Travis did not have bridesmaids or groomsmen. Instead, her brother Austin Swift served as Taylor’s Man of Honor and Jason Kelce was Travis’ Best Man. The ceremony joined both families together and was officiated by friend Adam Sandler.”

Days of media speculation led up to Friday’s ceremony, but the morning of theAssociated Press confirmedJuly 3 is the day Swift and Kelce would tie the knot at Madison Square Garden.A-listers picturedin formal attire walking to the wedding include Ed Sheeran, Bradley Cooper, Zoë Kravitz, Jack Antonoff, Gigi Hadid, Dakota Johnson, Ethan Hawke, MGK, Jason Sudeikis, Hugh Grant and Camila Cabello. Some reports claim that the guest list includes as many as 1,000 names.

Varietyreportedthat the digital wedding invites came complete with watermarks and NDAs. Other guests in attendance include AMC Theatres CEO Adam Aron, Steven Spielberg, Bob Iger, Dana Walden, Universal Music Group chairman Lucian Grainge, Republic Records founders Monte and Avery Lipman and Swift’s longtime tour promoter Louie Messina.
title_zh: 亞當·山德勒(Adam Sandler)主持了泰勒·斯威夫特(Taylor Swift)和特拉維斯·凱爾茲(Travis Kelce)的婚禮。
content_zh:
由杰克·邓恩(Jack Dunn)報導

亞當·山德勒(Adam Sandler)主持了泰勒·斯威夫特(Taylor Swift)和特拉維斯·凱爾西(Travis Kelce)在星光熠熠的麥迪遜廣場花園的婚禮。

這一消息是通過《綜藝》(Variety)獲得的新聞稿披露的，隨著斯威夫特和凱爾西的正式結婚公告發佈後不久，還包括了有關儀式和婚禮當天造型的其他雜項細節。

“新郎新娘的婚禮儀式造型由克里斯汀·迪奧(Christian Dior)高級訂製時裝設計。這些設計由迪奧女裝、男裝及高級訂製系列的創意總監喬納森·安德森(Jonathan Anderson)與新郎新娘密切合作創作，”新聞稿中寫道。“這是該設計師為世界知名名人創作的第一件高級訂製婚紗。他們的鞋子由克里斯汀·魯布坦(Christian Louboutin)定制，新娘佩戴了卡地亞(Cartier)珠寶。”

新聞稿接著提到：“泰勒和特拉維斯沒有伴娘或伴郎。相反，她的兄弟奧斯丁·斯威夫特(Austin Swift)擔任泰勒的榮譽男士，而傑森·凱爾西(Jason Kelce)則是特拉維斯的最佳男士。儀式將兩個家庭聯合在一起，由朋友亞當·山德勒主持。”

在週五的儀式之前，媒體的猜測持續了幾天，但美聯社(Associated Press)在婚禮當天早上確認，7月3日是斯威夫特和凱爾西在麥迪遜廣場花園結婚的日子。出席婚禮的A級明星包括艾德·希蘭(Ed Sheeran)、布拉德利·庫珀(Bradley Cooper)、佐伊·克拉維茨(Zoë Kravitz)、傑克·安東諾夫(Jack Antonoff)、吉吉·哈迪德(Gigi Hadid)、達科塔·約翰遜(Dakota Johnson)、伊桑·霍克(Ethan Hawke)、MGK、傑森·蘇戴基斯(Jason Sudeikis)、休·格蘭特(Hugh Grant)和卡米拉·卡貝羅(Camila Cabello)。一些報導稱，賓客名單上有多達1,000個名字。

《綜藝》(Variety)報導稱，數位婚禮邀請函上帶有水印和保密協議。其他出席的嘉賓包括AMC影院首席執行官亞當·阿隆(Adam Aron)、史蒂芬·斯皮爾伯格(Steven Spielberg)、鮑勃·艾格(Bob Iger)、達娜·沃爾登(Dana Walden)、環球音樂集團(Universal Music Group)主席盧西安·格蘭吉(Lucian Grainge)、共和國唱片(Republic Records)創始人蒙特·利普曼(Monte Lipman)和艾弗里·利普曼(Avery Lipman)，以及斯威夫特的長期巡演推廣人路易·梅西納(Louie Messina)。
